lines.zh: 缓慢挪动，腐肉摩擦地面。
lines.en: Move slowly, flesh grinding against the ground.
One leg drags. One step at a time.
Chew on rotting meat chunks.
Drag the corpse slowly.

lines.zh: 腐臭的触手摸索着前进。
lines.en: Foul-smelling tentacles feel the ground.
Feel towards the player.
Rotting fingers point at the player.
Corpse crawls slowly.
Flesh crawls in the crevice.
Rotting arm drags on the ground.
Shoulder crooked, I shuffle on.
My cracked lips open and close.
Flesh hangs loosely.
Rotting muscle relaxes.
Flesh sways gently in the wind.
Flesh moves silently.

lines.zh: 腐烂的手指在空中舞动。
lines.en: Fingers dance in the air.
Flesh swings slowly.

lines.zh: 腐烂的触手空荡荡地摆动。
lines.en: Empty tentacles swing.
Flesh sways gently.
Flesh drifts in the wind.

lines.zh: 腐烂的手指无力地挥舞。
lines.en: Fingers swing weakly.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，腐肉中露出眼睛。
lines.en: Stare at the player, eyes visible through the flesh.
Fingers point ahead.

lines.zh: 腐肉中的双眼凝视玩家。
lines.en: Eyes in the flesh stare at the player.
Muscle is exposed.

lines.zh: 腐肉下的眼睛盯着玩家。
lines.en: Eyes under the flesh stare at the player.
Arm points at the player.

lines.zh: 腐肉中露出白森森的骨头。
lines.en: White bones visible in the flesh.
Muscle tenses.
Finger joints point at the player.
Eye balls visible in the flesh.

lines.zh: 骨骼慢慢碎裂，疼痛让我难以呼吸。
lines.en: The bones are cracking, the pain is unbearable.

lines.zh: 腐烂的肌肉疼得我无法思考。
lines.en: Decaying flesh is agony, I can't think.

lines.zh: 腐烂的伤口流出冷冰冰的黑血。
lines.en: The cold, black blood flows from the wound.

lines.zh: 骨骼发出嘎吱声，每一步都是痛。
lines.en: The bones creak with every step, it hurts.

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肉下，我感觉自己快死了。
lines.en: In the decaying flesh, I feel like I'm dying.

lines.zh: 腐烂的骨头让我每动一步都痛苦。
lines.en: Decaying bones make every step agonizing.

lines.zh: 腐烂的肌肉让我的移动变得艰难。
lines.en: Decaying flesh makes movement difficult.

lines.zh: 我的骨头似乎即将断裂。
lines.en: My bones seem about to snap.

lines.zh: 腐烂的肌肉让我的呼吸变得困难。
lines.en: Decaying flesh makes it hard to breathe.

lines.zh: 腐烂的骨头和肌肉让我无法移动。
lines.en: Decaying bones and flesh make me immobile.

lines.zh: 腐烂的肌肟能闻到食物的香味。
lines.en: The rotten flesh can smell the food's aroma.
This is my new target.
I need to find something to eat.

lines.zh: 这镇子活着的东西，都是我的饭。
lines.en: Everything alive in this town is my meal.

lines.zh: 腐烂的骨头让我想起过去。
lines.en: Decaying bones remind me of the past.
I need to find some meat to bite.
This food looks fresh.

lines.zh: 腐烂的肌肉让我恢复力量。
lines.en: Decaying muscle helps me recover strength.
Corrupted flesh can make me active again.
The smell of the living, so sweet.

lines.zh: 你站在街心，我歪着撞过去。
lines.en: You stand mid-street, so I lurch into you.
I need your spot.
Move, I need to pass.
I need to push the obstacle aside.
Don't block me.
I need to move forward.
Stay away from me.

lines.zh: 这条巷子归我，你往后退。
lines.en: This alley is mine; step back.
I need to claim this space.

lines.zh: 我一步一晃，撞开了门板。
lines.en: Swaying step by step, I knock the door open.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道，让我们凑到一块。
lines.en: The smell of rot draws us together.

lines.zh: 同类越来越少，我闻到你的味了。
lines.en: Few of us left, and I smell you.

lines.zh: 尸群里，只有你和我还在走。
lines.en: In this herd, only you and I still walk.
I need to find my kind.

lines.zh: 末世的夜里，我只想找个同伴。
lines.en: On this dead night, I only want company.

lines.zh: 同伴都倒了，只剩我还在走。
lines.en: My kin have fallen; only I still walk.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道，让我们凑到一起。
lines.en: The smell of rot draws us together.
Even turned, I still miss home.

lines.zh: 寻找我的另一半来繁衍。
lines.en: Find my partner to breed.

lines.zh: 我需要找到我的同类来繁衍。
lines.en: I need to find my kind to breed.

lines.zh: 我感觉到了你的血肉气息。
lines.en: I feel your flesh.
You need my strength.
You are ours now.
Join us.
Not enough flesh.
I bring you to the group.
No mercy for us.

lines.zh: 我捡起一只断鞋，套在脚上。
lines.en: I pick up a torn shoe and pull it on.
Blood and flesh, my sustenance.
You are chosen.

lines.zh: 从土里爬出来，先抖抖泥。
lines.en: I climb out of the dirt and shake off the mud.
It cannot escape.
We are here.
You won't go far.
It belongs to us.
Chase its shadow.
It belongs here.
My brother is coming.
We will consume all.
You will join the line.

lines.zh: 我这双手，先伸出来找你。
lines.en: These hands reach out for you first.
The wind brings the smell of blood.
My head snaps around.
A shadow shifts by the wall.
My steps quicken; I want to chase.
I have you locked, do not move.
His end is now.

lines.zh: 我把手指弯成钩，朝你伸。
lines.en: I curl my fingers into hooks and reach for you.
Pain will change you.
Your end begins now.
It will be my sustenance.
Bring it into the end.
Its screams will accompany us.
Its flesh will nourish us.
Pull it into the abyss.
My mouth opens; my throat rattles.
My fingers curl into hooks.
Limping, I close the distance.
My eyes fix on your neck.
I reach out with both hands.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的声音越来越急。
lines.en: The sound in my throat grows urgent.
Only two steps left.
You run; I stumble after.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶嘶，我要啃掉你的骨头！
lines.en: Sssss... I'll chew your bones!

lines.zh: 你逃不掉，我的牙齿锋利！
lines.en: You can't run, my teeth are sharp!
Don't be afraid, my goal is to eat!

lines.zh: 腐烂的力量让我更强壮！
lines.en: Rot makes me stronger!

lines.zh: 你闻到了吗？腐烂的气息！
lines.en: Smell it? The stench of decay!
You're just food in my eyes!
I need your flesh to recover!

lines.zh: 你脖子上的脉，跳得真响。
lines.en: The pulse in your neck beats so loudly.

lines.zh: 我用肩膀把你顶到砖墙上。
lines.en: I drive my shoulder into you and pin you to the bricks.
Eat you to grow strong!

lines.zh: 我的牙嵌进你的小臂，不松。
lines.en: My teeth sink into your forearm and stay.
My nails dig into your skin!
I press you against the wall!
One bite tears off your sleeve!
I throw my whole weight at you!
After this bite, you'll turn too.

lines.zh: 腐烂的空气中有新的灵魂！
lines.en: A soul is here to rot!

lines.zh: 末地的腐朽气息中诞生！
lines.en: Born from decay in the Nether!
A new Walker from the corpse!
I am reborn from the rot!
In the dark, I wait for you!
Soul enters the corpse, I am!
Awake in the stench of death!
Soul craves, born from decay!
In the rot, I am reborn!
New life from the corpse!
Fingers twitch under the rubble.
I push myself up off the ground.
One more swaying shadow in the street.
My throat makes a sound before I stand.

lines.zh: 灼热的火焰烧灼我的皮肤。
lines.en: The searing flames burn my skin.
Fell from a height, bones shattered.
Black blood in the water chokes me.

lines.zh: 爆炸的冲击波撕裂我的皮肉。
lines.en: The explosion's shock wave rips through my flesh.

lines.zh: 箭头从我背里穿出来了。
lines.en: The arrowhead came out through my back.

lines.zh: 魔法的冲击撕裂了我的骨骼。
lines.en: Magic's impact tore through my bones.

lines.zh: 胃里空得发响，我走不动了。
lines.en: My stomach growls hollowly, and I can't walk.

lines.zh: 闪电劈中了我，电击撕裂我的肉体。
lines.en: Lightning struck me, electric shock tears through my flesh.

lines.zh: 虚空的寒冷吞噬我的灵魂。
lines.en: The void's cold consumes my soul.
